scope: factual late-delay/development-status follow-up only; no probability or verdict

case.question: GTA VI released by November 30?
case.release_definition: publicly available for purchase or download in US; early access, beta, other pre-release availability or leaks excluded; official Rockstar/Take-Two information resolves

findings.source: Bloomberg Businessweek, Jason Schreier, Inside the Making of Grand Theft Auto 6
findings.retrieval: direct article GET returned 403; no article text parsed from the private response
findings.limitation: Original primary report body inaccessible to direct capture; web search indexed metadata and excerpts only.

findings.source: GamesRadar+, Anthony McGlynn, GTA 6 is still undergoing changes despite releasing next month, Rockstar boss says
findings.finding: Article attributes to Schreier’s Oct 14 Bloomberg reporting a direct quote from Rockstar technology director Phil Hooker: “The game is never completely settled.” The article also paraphrases leadership as saying the game “simply wasn’t ready yet” when discussing prior delay rationale. This supports ongoing changes as a general development fact; it does not specify critical-path blockers, gold/certification status, review-copy distribution, or a new delay.
findings.limitation: Secondary report quoting a direct management interview; no explicit current delay announcement or build-complete/test-status statement verified. Ongoing changes alone do not establish schedule risk.

coverage_gap: Within two reads, no accessible original Bloomberg article body and no explicit current gold/certification/build-complete/test-status/review-copy statement was verified. No inference of “no delay” or “no issue” is made from absence.
